title: 置换在对称变换群中的应用
Permutations and geometric symmetry
用顶点记录一个对称
Record a symmetry by its vertices
text: 若一个几何对象由有限顶点集 V 决定，对称就诱导 V 上的置换。若逐点固定所有顶点的对称只有恒等变换，则这个表示是单射。
Symmetries induce permutations of a finite vertex set. The representation is injective if fixing all vertices forces the symmetry to be the identity.
example: 正 n 边形的等距对称由三个不共线顶点的像决定，因此顶点置换完整记录其对称。
An isometry of a regular polygon is determined by three noncollinear vertex images, so its vertex permutation records it faithfully.

title: 正多边形的全部对称
All symmetries of a regular polygon
text: r 为逆时针旋转 2π/n，s 为一条对称轴的反射。一个顶点有 n 种像，相邻顶点有 2 种方向，因此至多 2n 个对称；上述变换恰好实现全部可能。
Let r rotate by 2π/n and s be a reflection. A vertex has n possible images and a neighboring vertex has two choices, giving at most 2n symmetries; rotations and reflections realize all of them.
proof: 等距变换保持边，所以选定一个顶点的像后，相邻顶点只能送到它的两个邻点之一。
Isometries preserve edges. Once a vertex image is fixed, its neighbor must map to one of two neighbors.
这个选择确定整个多边形上的顶点置换，故最多 2n 个。
This determines the remaining vertex permutation, giving at most 2n possibilities.
n 个旋转 rᵏ 和 n 个反射 rᵏs 两两不同，全部都是对称，所以正好 2n 个。
The n rotations and n reflections are distinct symmetries, attaining the bound.

title: 关系式就是计算规则
Relations as calculation rules
text: 反射把旋转方向反过来。指数分别按模 n 与模 2 计算，得到每个乘积的标准形式。
Reflection reverses the direction of rotation. Reduce the rotation exponent modulo n and the reflection exponent modulo 2 to obtain a normal form.
example: 在 D₄ 中，s r=r⁻¹s=r³s，而 r s 与它不同；这解释了旋转与反射通常不交换。
In D₄, sr=r⁻¹s=r³s differs from rs. Rotation and reflection generally do not commute.

title: 四面体与 A₄
The tetrahedron and A₄
text: 正四面体的保定向旋转群有 12 个元素：恒等、绕四个顶点轴的 ±120° 旋转共 8 个、绕三对对边中点轴的 180° 旋转共 3 个。
The rotation group of a regular tetrahedron has 12 elements: identity, eight ±120° vertex-axis rotations and three 180° rotations through opposite edge midpoints.
proof: 旋转由一个面及其有向顶点顺序的像决定，故至多 4×3=12 个；列出的旋转已达到上界。
A rotation is determined by an oriented face image, giving at most 4×3=12 possibilities; the listed rotations attain the bound.
顶点轴旋转诱导三轮换；对边轴旋转诱导双对换。这些置换全为偶置换。
Vertex-axis rotations induce 3-cycles; opposite-edge-axis rotations induce double transpositions. All are even.
顶点作用是单射，像包含 A₄ 的全部 12 个元素，因此与 A₄ 同构。
The vertex action is injective, and its image contains all 12 elements of A₄.
example: 若允许反射等反向等距变换，正四面体的完整对称群则同构于 S₄。
Including orientation-reversing isometries gives the full tetrahedral symmetry group S₄.

title: 立方体与 S₄
The cube and S₄
text: 立方体的 24 个保定向旋转作用在四条体对角线上，得到 S₄。这里被置换的是四条直线，不是八个顶点。
The 24 rotations of a cube permute its four body-diagonal lines, giving S₄. The permuted objects are lines, not the eight vertices.
proof: 一个面的像有 6 种选择，面上一个顶点的像有 4 种选择，且都由旋转实现，所以旋转群有 24 个元素。
A face has six image choices and a chosen vertex on it has four; all are realized by rotations, giving 24 elements.
取四条对角线的方向向量 v₁=(1,1,1)、v₂=(1,−1,−1)、v₃=(−1,1,−1)、v₄=(−1,−1,1)。若旋转 R 固定每条直线，则 Rvᵢ=εᵢvᵢ。
Take the four listed diagonal vectors. If a rotation fixes each diagonal line, Rvᵢ=εᵢvᵢ with εᵢ=±1.
任意两不同向量的内积是 −1；保持内积迫使 εᵢεⱼ=1，故所有符号相同。因 det R=1，不能全部为 −1，只能 R=I。
Distinct vectors have inner product −1, so preserving inner products forces all signs to agree. Determinant 1 excludes −I, hence R=I.
作用于是单射；源群和 S₄ 均为 24 阶，故为同构。
The action is injective; both groups have order 24, so it is an isomorphism.

question: 本文 D₅ 的阶是？
What is the order of D₅ in our notation?
reason: Dₙ 表示正 n 边形完整对称群，含 n 个旋转及 n 个反射。
Dₙ contains n rotations and n reflections.

question: 正四面体保定向旋转群同构于？
The rotation group of a tetrahedron is isomorphic to?
reason: 顶点置换给出恰好 12 个偶置换。
Its vertex action gives exactly the 12 even permutations.

question: 立方体旋转群与 S₄ 的同构用到哪一集合？
Which set gives the cube rotation group an isomorphism with S₄?
reason: 四条体对角线的置换作用是忠实的，源和目标同为 24 阶。
The action on four body diagonals is faithful, and both groups have order 24.

question: 利用关系式计算 D₅ 中 (r²s)(r³s)，并解释为什么结果是旋转。
Compute (r²s)(r³s) in D₅ and explain why it is a rotation.
reason: sr³=r⁻³s，所以乘积为 r²r⁻³s²=r⁻¹=r⁴。两个反射复合保持方向，因此是旋转。
Since sr³=r⁻³s, the product is r⁻¹=r⁴. Two reflections compose to an orientation-preserving symmetry.
